description: USB-A female receptacle, 4-pin, right-angle through-hole with shield tabs. Standard USB 2.0 host/device port. For USB-to-UART bridges, MCU USB device ports, and panel-mount host ports.
name: usb-a-receptacle-4p
watch_out_for: USB 2.0 only — not USB 3.0. Shield tabs MUST be connected to GND for EMI and ESD protection. D+/D- need 22Ω series termination for full-speed. VBUS needs appropriate current limiting and ESD protection.
